records.description: Justblank is a full-cycle AEO platform built for the AI search era. Start with free AEO analytics to see how AI engines understand and rank your brand inside AI answers. Track prompt visibility, competitor mentions, and prompt volume across leading LLMs. Turn insights into action by creating and optimizing AEO-ready content to increase visibility in AI-generated answers, all in one place.

records.name: ChoreWard
records.tagline: Teach kids delayed gratification with real-time allowances
records.description: I built ChoreWard because I wanted to teach my kids self-control and delayed gratification early. Not by cutting off screens, but by giving them real-time visibility into their choices. Kids have an allowance budget and gain or lose points based on their actions and screen time.

records.name: Pathmode: AI-Powered Design OS
records.tagline: From journey maps to shipped features in one workflow
records.description: I built Pathmode because journey maps were becoming expensive PDFs instead of shipped features. Most tools stop at visualization. You map pain points, then manually recreate everything in Figma. The handoff is broken. Pathmode closes the loop: Upload customer research → AI maps insights to journey steps → Generate design specs that move straight to development. Built by designers, for designers. No more manual handoff. Just a unified workflow that turns insights into features.

records.name: InterviewRep
records.tagline: AI live copilot to help sales teams crush their interviews
records.description: InterviewRep is an AI live copilot built by sales professionals to help sales reps, sales enablement teams, and sales leaders crush their interviews. Get real-time AI coaching during sales interviews with instant feedback and comprehensive preparation tools. Perfect for hiring top sales talent, training sales teams, and acing technical sales, behavioral, and leadership interviews. Built for sales, by sales.

records.name: Binance Clone Script
records.tagline: Binance Clone Script for Secure Crypto Exchange Launch
records.description: Binance Clone Script is a powerful, ready-to-launch crypto exchange solution built for businesses that want speed, security, and scalability. It comes with a high-performance matching engine, multi-crypto wallets, liquidity integration, spot and derivatives trading, secure APIs, and built-in KYC/AML tools. With a flexible modular architecture, it allows easy customization, fast deployment, low-latency trading, and smooth scalability for global crypto markets.

records.name: SentNotes
records.tagline: A social wellness hub for holistic health.
records.description: SentNotes rethinks wellness as a connected system, not isolated metrics. Unlike apps that focus on just fitness or nutrition, SentNotes combines activity, meals, mood, sleep, habits, and social motivation in one seamless experience. With Alison, an AI health coach, users get personalized insights that evolve with real behavior—plus community, challenges and buddies that turn consistency into something social, supportive, and rewarding.

records.name: Photo Cleaner: Swypic
records.tagline: Tinder for your gallery. Clean storage offline
records.description: Swypic transforms the tedious chore of gallery cleaning into a satisfying, gamified experience. Unlike cloud-based tools, we prioritize 100% Privacy: all processing happens offline on your device. No photos ever leave your phone. Standout Features: Tinder-style "Swipe to Clean" UI Safety-first Recycle Bin (undo mistakes anytime) Massive storage savings in minutes Zero internet required Perfect for digital hoarders and creators wanting to reclaim space fast and securely.

records.name: BetterWrite
records.tagline: Minimalist writing editor with vim mode
records.description: BetterWrite offers a beautiful, distraction-free writing environment designed for those who value simplicity and focus.
